primary_definition: For each tier, apply alpha_gc=(1-w_gc)^(k_g-1) at the purchase-cohort row endpoint and Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across all positive cells; retain q_row<=0.05.
sensitivity_definition: Apply row and subject-column endpoint probabilities, BH-adjust all 2E endpoint tests, and retain an edge if either endpoint has q<=0.05. This is sensitivity only because degree-one subject columns have alpha=0.
interpretation_boundary: Retention means local prominence within a cohort allocation profile under the stated disparity null. It is not a between-cohort test and does not identify wealth, ideology, coordination, causality, or information advantage.
formation_size_definition: September 2024 Trump/Harris Yes taker BUY USDC, pooled quantiles; boundary ties retained
